title: The Graduation
subtitle: The stage, taken back -- remove: true
description: The college takes its word back at the door: the stage reward here
carries `remove: true`, so `my_pack:inducted` is taken away rather
than granted, and the rite's flag ends where it started.
A stage grant and a stage removal are the same reward type read in
two directions -- the summons wrote the flag, the graduation unpicks
it -- and what remains is the diploma, which is the point of the
whole ceremony and materially more useful than the flag ever was.
